topics.title: DP Fundamentals
topics.task: Caching: Read N. Create an array of size N+1 where arr[0]=0, arr[1]=1, and every other index is the sum of all previous indices. Print arr[N].

topics.title: Fibonacci Optimization
topics.task: Read integer N. Calculate the N-th Fibonacci number efficiently using DP (Memoization or Tabulation). F(0)=0, F(1)=1. Print the result.

topics.title: 0/1 Knapsack Problem
topics.task: Read N (items) and W (knapsack capacity). Read N weights on the next line. Read N values on the last line. Print the maximum value you can carry.

topics.title: Longest Common Subsequence (LCS)
topics.task: Read two string sequences, each on a new line. Compute and print the length of their Longest Common Subsequence using a DP matrix.
